name: ZKTrustLLM-Agents L4 — Multi-Model & Multi-Agent n8n Evaluation

parameters.content:
ZKTrustLLM-Agents L4 — Multi-Model & Multi-Agent n8n Evaluation

Purpose:
This workflow implements the supervisor-requested extension of the experimental section. It evaluates AI-model/tool behaviour around the local ZKTrustLLM-Agents L4 evidence pipeline using Claude, DeepSeek, and Mistral.

Stage E:
Cross-model single-agent tool-scenario evaluation.
Scenarios:
1. Evidence-summary generation
2. Claim-boundary review
3. Policy-ladder checking

Stage F:
Meaningful multi-agent evaluation.
Cases:
1. Task decomposition
2. Agent collaboration
3. Failure recovery
4. Verification agent
5. Model disagreement resolution

Measured outcomes:
Accuracy, valid JSON rate, execution time, p95 latency, estimated cost, failed runs, consistency, and improvement over the single-agent baseline.

Claim boundary:
This evaluates AI-model/tool and multi-agent orchestration behaviour around the local n8n artifact. It is not claimed as production O-RAN deployment, packet-capture network benchmarking, public-chain benchmarking, or full media-plane QoE validation.
